snippet.title: Coaches: Vehicle Ownership & Job Schedule
snippet.description:
Ready to swap cargo for passengers? Today, we're sharing more details about the upcoming Coaches DLC for Euro Truck Simulator 2, including coach ownership and how you'll plan and take on passenger transport jobs. All aboard!  

Add the Coaches DLC to your Steam wishlist 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3809270/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Coaches/#game_area_purchase
